title: test(app-shell, data-objectstack): pin the access verdicts a package-id app URL reaches (objectui#12285)
body:
Fixes #12285
Clause-②: no

## What this does

A member opening a withheld app at its package-id URL now sees the access-denied screen, with no console change. This PR pins that.

- `AppContent` hands the URL segment to `probeAppAccess` as it stands.
- Since objectstack-ai/objectstack#23183, published in `@objectstack/*` `18.0.0-next.2` (which `main` resolves since objectui#12626), the by-name app route answers a package-id key: `403 PERMISSION_DENIED` for a withheld app, `404` for an unknown package, and `200` with the app under its own `name` for a holder.
- The adapter's `probeMetaItemAccess` reads those answers the same way it reads them for a name.

`probeAppAccess`, `probeMetaItemAccess` and `AppAccessVerdict` keep their shapes, so `Clause-②: no`.

## Live reading (published 18.0.0-next.2, `e2e/live/ci/start-backend.sh`, member `phone.demo@example.com`)

| URL | by-name answer | screen |
|---|---|---|
| `/apps/com.objectstack.setup` (member) | 403 `PERMISSION_DENIED` | `app-access-denied` |
| `/apps/com.example.no-such-pkg` (member) | 404 `RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND` | `app-not-found` |
| `/apps/setup` (member) | 403 `PERMISSION_DENIED` | `app-access-denied` |
| `/apps/com.objectstack.setup` (admin) | not asked: the app is in the list | the app opens (System Overview) |

Screenshots and the readings are on the branch `claude/issue-12285-evidence`, under `evidence/12285/`.

## Pins

- `AppContent.deniedVsUnpublished.test.tsx`, describe "a package-id URL reaches the same verdicts (objectui#12285)", 4 cases:
  - a withheld package id shows access denied, after exactly one by-name request made with the key the URL carries;
  - an unknown package id shows not found;
  - the by-name URL keeps its denied verdict;
  - a holder opens the app with no probe.
- `appAccessProbe.test.ts`, describe "a package-id key (objectui#12285)", 3 cases: 403 is `denied`, 404 is `not_found`, and a 200 under the app's own name is `granted`.

No source change, so there is no ablation. The changeset has an empty frontmatter (releases nothing) because `check-changeset-presence` covers test files under `src/`.
